dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: The guards have reported seeing some ores nearby. Condessence Crystals, apparently, and no small amount of Magical Crystal Ore either... Not exactly headline news though.

dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: If only we had someone from the Children of Echoes here, we could have consulted them about the quality... Though as I see it, they're all pretty much the same anyway. Every kind of material has its use, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: Anyway, if you're in need of ore, you can go mine some here.
